current_slot_pair_scope: Relations between currently active definitions only; historical-version nodes and all version edges remain in the semantic graph catalog.
limitation: Prepared structural targets only: no learned relationship decoder, activation analysis, model query or causal intervention. Each graph uses only visible assignment versions; the output expression is absent unless explicitly visible at the final checkpoint. Relations are syntactic def-use, strict ancestry and version succession, not numerical equality, functional influence or evidence that a model represents these relationships. Support/prior summaries weight structural groups equally after deduplicating graph states within each group; numeric and naming relatives are not independent replications. Fixed or one-class labels can make later decoding trivial. Graph variation alone does not qualify captures, independent generalization, an ownership mechanism or mechanism C.
matched_condition_consistency_scope: Same base and canonical-program signature; explicit counterfactual rewiring variants may differ.
output_visibility: Only separate explicit final-assignment views include output labels; hidden output is absent, not a negative label.
prefix_overlap_interpretation: Shared partial graphs across split-disjoint full components are reported, not rejected or counted as novel independent structures.
semantic_graph_signature: Canonical version IDs/slots/current-or-obsolete status, direct/strict/succession edges and explicit output referents/ancestors; excludes assignment positions, use operand paths, numeric literals and surface names.
statistical_unit: Structural group; unique graph states within each group, never raw row/naming/numeric counts.
